LESSON: WHO IS CREATION

Grade: PP1
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: GOD’S
Topic 1.1: Who is CREATION

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Who is CREATION. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Where does He live?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify God as his/her heavenly • Learners could be guided to recite simple Father. short poems on God as his/her Sole
2. respect God as the Father of Creator, based on respect for mankind, God.(Genesis 1:)

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify God as his/her heavenly • Learners could be guided to recite simple Father. short poems on God as his/her Sole
   In simple words: practise until you can identify God as his/her heavenly • Learners could be guided to recite simple Father. short poems on God as his/her Sole. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. respect God as the Father of Creator, based on respect for mankind, God.(Genesis 1:)
   In simple words: practise until you can respect God as the Father of Creator, based on respect for mankind, God.(Genesis 1:). Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Who is CREATION using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Who is CREATION in the examples.
2. Explain Who is CREATION to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Who is CREATION.
4. Show that you can: identify God as his/her heavenly • Learners could be guided to recite simple Father. short poems on God as his/her Sole

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Who is CREATION using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Who is CREATION important for a PP1 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. In groups learners to sing songs on God Creator and Heavenly Father for as their Heavenly Father to develop the personal development. virtue of love(Matthew 6:9)
2. Able to sing a song on God’s
3. Able to sing a song on God’s creation God’s creation creation
4. Mention their names 1. What is your CREATION awareness
5. Learners are guided in small groups to name? b) Sing songs as special creature mention each other’s’ names. (Isaiah 43:1) 2. Who created you? (6 Lessons) created in the image and likeness
